notes: No PR opened. The existing break_block hook fires before block removal, while the actual experience is sampled only after loot and item-position random draws in GameLevel::block_dropped. Exposing an initial mutable amount requires choosing between sampling early (changing vanilla RNG order) and a different public contract for a deferred override (for example Option<u32>); those APIs are incompatible. The issue does not specify how to reconcile the early event with vanilla's later sampling. No code changes made.
